title: Interfaces
explain: An interface describes the shape of an object: which properties it has and their types. Any object with that shape is accepted, whether or not it was declared with the interface. Use `?` for optional properties and `readonly` for ones that must not change.
exercise: Define a `Product` interface with an optional `discount`, then write a function that prints the final price.
tip: `interface` and `type` overlap heavily for object shapes. Pick one style and stay consistent across the project.
